Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misframed the task by prioritizing an assumed immediate cause (pneumonia) and treating Huntington’s disease as background, despite the question asking why the performer died and authoritative sources citing Huntington’s disease/its complications. This bias was then reinforced by instructing to default to pneumonia if only “complications of Huntington’s disease” was stated, steering the process toward an incorrect answer rather than the correct cause (Huntington’s disease).
